audit_progression.summary: Parallel additive residuals violated mass conservation; Stage 2 supervised unmeasured X_d; EKF clipped eigenvalues and suffered oxygen stiffness drift; single-batch fit had kappa > 10^4.

Converted to serial stoichiometry, exact discrete adjoint VJP with zero X_d supervision, Exponential-Rosenbrock positivity, and unclipped expm EKF. Literature-grounded audit exposed Stage-1 oracle k_d0 leak (D1), inflated train+test R2 reporting (D2), q_A double-gating (D3), S_feed fault leak (D4), uncalibrated k_La0 (D5), GAM convergence/OOD (D6/D7), and ALCOA+ truncation (D8).

Remediated D1-D9 and post-review hardening: pure nominal k_d0 in 6-param Stage-1 iDoE, held-out 5-regime GAM-86 (B=15) validation, subspace Mahalanobis + stiff Van Loan NIS/SPE dual gate with control fallback, 5 L -> 1000 L matched hydrodynamic defaults, full SHA-256 ALCOA+ hash-chain persistence across reloads, and 25/25 passing pytest suite.
